name: B10-0500/2025 – After § 1 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 1c. Calls for the entry badges of the registered lobbyists from Shein, AliExpress and all platforms concerned to be revoked, as has already been done for Amazon lobbyists, if the senior executives of these platforms refuse to appear before its Committee on the Internal Market and Consumer Protection;
